chapter: Rhythm and blues, the Howard Theatre and later years
title: Playing Charlie's in Georgetown and visiting Earl Hines in Oakland
summary: Phillips gigs around Washington and sits in at Charlie's; recently he visited his brother in Berkeley and Earl Hines sent a car to his penthouse.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And you've been working around town in various places.
You work in Charlie's at Georgetown. You sit in quite a bit. You play with a lot of good people there.
Recently, before making this tape, you got back from seeing Earl Hines out there at his place in California.
Berkeley. They live just about 9 miles apart. Because Earl... I called Calvin Keyes up, the guitar player, and he said, 'Man, we're going to send over there and
get you right quick." So Earl sent a car over there and picked me up -- over at my brother's. And we went up to his place. So went up there... He got a penthouse. I went up there and had a ball...
